items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And I got Brown interested... So we got this job in the Cotton Club... After I studied, Andrew Brown, he studied. And then when Jefferson come in the band, Jefferson studied.

ctx.x: Dawson! That damn thing stayed in my ear for years, because it was so beautiful. And I just always wanted to get a good tone. It just stayed with me. So I down and studied with Merle, and he started to show me how to blow(?) it. And I got Brown interested.

But let me back up. So where we got our big break was when Duke Ellington went to California to do the picture Three Little Words. So they chose our band to replace him. See, Mills was managing both bands, so it was kind of easy. But it was easy, too, because the Cotton Club was crazy about our band anyway, because The Missourians had been in the Cotton Club before and done a good job. So we got this job in the Cotton Club.
